title: Advertisement - Sale of Compendium published on Diamond Jubilee of High Court of_Gujarat
text:

HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
Sola, Ahmedabad-380 060.
Tele-Fax: 079-27664611 Ext.407; E-mail: ar-cbranch@gujarat.gov.in
ADVERTISEMENT
No.HC/01/2023
SALE OF COMPENDIUM PUBLISHED ON
DIAMOND JUBILEE OF HIGH coURT OF GUJARAT
The Gujarat High Court has decided to put on SALE 56 copies of
the Diamond Jubilee Compendium of this High Court. The said
Compendium contains important information relating to various
branches of Law and the High Court of Gujarat; which is useful for all
stakeholders particularly the common man.
The compendium consists of 4 Volumes and the price of each set
of 04 books is Rs.6000/-. Titles of four volumes are as under:
1) Pictorial journey of the High Court of Gujarat -
Reminiscences and Reflections,
2) Bedrock of the Judicial System -
Picturesque Eye-view District Judiciary,
3) Law for the Common Man
4) Legacy and Law.
The Compendiums would be available till the stock lasts.
Interested buyers are requested to contact the Assistant Registrar,
Admin C' Branch, Gujarat High Court, during Office Hours at contact
numbers given above.
Date:/03/2023 Registrar General
High Court of Gujarat
